tieuDeEn: Brothers and sisters are flesh and blood, not strangers passing on the road: we share the same parents, so we love each other – sharing food and clothes, because kindness is worth more than being full and warm.

dichXuoi.en: The love between brothers and sisters is not like that between strangers on the road. Because we share the same parents, we must love each other.

dichXuoi.vi: Thương nhau thì nhường nhau miếng ăn, nhường nhau áo mặc, chăn đắp. No ấm chẳng đáng bao nhiêu, tấm lòng thơm thảo mới thật là quý.
dichXuoi.en: If we love each other, we share our food and give each other clothes and blankets. Being full and warm matters little; a kind, generous heart is what is truly precious.

en: Cô Hà welcomes you to lesson twenty-two of “Lên Tám”. Last time we understood the sacred bond of people who share the same blood and the same family. Today we'll see how that flesh-and-blood love is different from how we treat strangers, and how everyday sharing and kindness between siblings makes us good people. Listen carefully.
When we think of the love of flesh and blood, it's not like that of strangers on the road; since we share the same parents, we should love each other.
If we love each other, we share our food; if we care for each other, we share clothes and blankets; being full and warm matters little – how much love there is in kindness!

The poem uses a clear contrast: “strangers on the road” meet and pass by without any bond, but brothers and sisters share a deep, flesh-and-blood love. Because we come from the same roots and grow up under the same roof, loving, protecting and caring for each other is the most natural and sacred duty, one every child should keep in their heart.

To show that love every day, the next verse gives very concrete actions: when there's a tasty cake, siblings split it and give each other the bigger half; when it gets cold, they offer the warm blanket or thick coat to their brother or sister. The last lines are moving: food and clothes are not worth much and being full is only for a while, but a kind, giving heart is precious forever and fills the home with happiness.
